location: Das Spiel; next starting-player token; experienced-player setup; credits
firstPlayerRule: In the basic game, the player who most resembles the game’s monster begins and takes the starting-player token.
clarifications: After the monster moves, pass the starting-player token to the left; its new holder begins the next movement phase.
In the experienced-player setup, the player to the left of whoever placed the final floor tile takes the starting-player token and begins instead.
interpretation: This is an English summary of the identified German rulebook. Its comparison refers to the game’s monster, not an arbitrary monster chosen by the group.
evidenceNotes: Rendered German pages 3, 6 and 7 were inspected before preparation. The basic criterion is not applied to the advanced floor-tile setup. Rio Grande’s separately hosted English Fearsome Floors PDF corroborates the title and game identity but includes an alternative-selection sentence absent from this German passage; that alternative is not silently imported into this edition.
